get_image_features returns visual pooler_output which is inserted into language-model inputs; physical pre-decoder feature interception exists.
libmtmd maintains an aggregated output embedding buffer for encoded media batches.
llama-server obtains mtmd_batch_get_output_embd and forwards the same media embedding buffer into decoder processing.
VLM-derived strong embedding spaces are produced with explicit contrastive embedding adaptation; raw generative features should not be assumed calibrated.
Qwen3-VL embedding models use dedicated multi-stage embedding training, strengthening the raw-feature counterhypothesis.
adaptive quadtree visual-token reduction exploits GUI spatial/temporal redundancy while preserving position structure.
GUI backgrounds can carry state-transition information and recency-weighted history compression is useful; naive ROI removal can lose context.
naive full-image visual memory can worsen action-level failures; action-grounded local visual memory is a stronger candidate.
reported auto-fit memory accounting can omit mmproj, leading to OOM near VRAM limits.
reported Qwen3.5 vision correctness varies with batch/ubatch settings on tested systems.
reported recent Qwen3.5 multimodal CUDA/M-RoPE failure matrix depends on runtime flags and prompt/image positioning.
reported backend fallback can increase image encoding from sub-second to >10s on one GPU setup, showing runtime build/backend effects are material.

source_ancestry_rule: Issue reports are failure evidence, not universal truth; reproduce on target VPS before promotion. Official configs/runtime code establish structure, not target performance.
